This scene wasn't created entirely with CGI!

Instead of relying purely on CGI, the crew used practical forced perspective, negative space, and set details like furniture, pillars, and molding to form unsettling human silhouettes. In the story, Beth experiences strange occurrences inside her late husband's lakeside home and uncovers disturbing secrets.

The Night House (2020) is a 110-minute supernatural psychological horror film directed by David Bruckner and written by Ben Collins and Luke Piotrowski, starring Rebecca Hall as widow Beth. After her architect husband Owen takes his own life, Beth stays alone in their secluded lakeside home and uncovers dark secrets involving his past, hidden architecture, and a disturbing presence.

source_details.title: The Night House
source_details.synopsis: The Night House is a 2020 supernatural psychological horror film directed by David Bruckner, and written by Ben Collins and Luke Piotrowski. It stars Rebecca Hall as a widow who discovers a dark secret about the house her recently deceased architect husband built. Other cast members are Sarah Goldberg, Evan Jonigkeit, Stacy Martin, and Vondie Curtis-Hall. It premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 24, 2020, and was theatrically released in the United States on August 20, 2021, by Searchlight Pictures. It received positive reviews and was nominated for several awards, including Saturn Award for Best Horror Film.
